# `file` check

Check that a file exists (or not), its permissions, age and contents.

```yaml
checks:
  example:
    type: file
    path: /var/run/app/ready
    expect:
      age: { warn: 5m, fail: 15m }
```

## Keys

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` **(required)** | string |  | Path to the file or directory (~ is expanded). |
| `expect` | mapping |  | What counts as healthy. |
| `expect.exists` | bool | `true` | true: the path must exist. false: it must not exist (e.g. a maintenance flag). |
| `expect.mode` | string |  | Exact permission bits in octal, e.g. "0600". |
| `expect.age` | {warn, fail} duration |  | Time since last modification. Triggers when the value is above the threshold. |
| `expect.contains` | string |  | Text the file must contain (first 10MiB are searched). |

Every check also accepts the [common keys](../config.md#common-check-keys).

One-liner: `medic check file <path> [--set key=value ...]`
